demoResetIntro: [es] This puts the demo back the way it started. Use it before a walkthrough, or when testing has left the data in a mess. It only runs when you press the button; nothing resets it by itself.
demoResetRemoves: [es] Removed: everything anyone changed or added to the members, groups, events, rosters, bulletins and weekly tasks. The demo data comes back as it was.
demoResetKeeps: [es] Kept: everyone's sign-in accounts, the email allowlist and the history of changes. The reset is added to that history.

homeMissionIntro: [es] Our mission is to love God, love others, and make disciples while actively committing to community, investing and inviting, and redeeming our county.

homeAbout: [es] A group of Christians who strive to follow God and serve him to the best of our ability.
homeCard1Title: [es] Love God, Love Others, and Make Disciples
homeCard1Text: [es] God has a mission and he invites us to join him in what he is doing. Our lives are to be dedicated to loving God in all that we do, loving others every opportunity we get, and making as many disciples as possible.
homeCard2Text: [es] When we become Christians, God gives us a family. We are to be present when the church gathers to encourage and uplift one another, to celebrate the joys of life together and support one another in times of sorrow.
homeCard3Text: [es] We make disciples by investing in others and inviting them to worship and serve alongside us. We are to use dinner tables just as Jesus did to get to know people and let them know we care.
homeCard4Text: [es] If there are people in need, we are to help them. If there are people who are lost, we are to tell them about Jesus. Our mission is to leave our mark on the places where we live so that others will come to know God and glorify him.
